# 06 — Bot-harness runtime spec for holtburger-web

Everything below verified against source on this box. **The doc's line refs have all drifted** — I trusted code and tabulate the drift so `url-flags.md` can be repaired.

**Default-value drift** (orchestrator opts, `runAutonomousLogin`): `connectTimeoutMs` code `25000` (`9561`) vs doc `5000`; `spawnTimeoutMs` code `20000` (`9565`) vs doc `10000`; `maxRetries` code **`0`** (`9506`,`9526`) vs doc `3`. The dance is now **opt-in**; a single clean Connect is the default (ACE boots any stale session "in favor of new connection").

**Renderer default is 3D**, not 2D: `get("renderer") !== "2d"` (`index.html:2524`, `3070`). ⚠️ **k1's header comment ("Renders 2D — no `?renderer=3d`") is stale**: k1 passes no `renderer` param, so it actually runs the 3D path. `nullRender`/`renderOnDemand`/`netDrainHz` are read only inside the 3D module (`scene3d/index.js`) and are therefore effective by default; to force the legacy PIXI path you must pass `?renderer=2d`.

## `__bootState` transition graph (verified `setBootState` sites)

```
init (5172) → form-shown (5261) → connecting (5289)
   → [kicking (9753,9776) → reconnecting (9778)]   ← only when ?maxRetries>0
   → char-list-ready (5561)  [handle.characterList() ready]
   → spawning (5666)
   → in-world (7087)   ← fired on recv kind=7 EnteredWorld (PlayerDescription/StartGame)
   → ready (…)         ← render/atmosphere terminal signal
   (error at any step: 5273,5673,9480,9816,9898,9902,9904)
```

`ready` has **three setters, all in `scene3d/index.js`** (render-side, not protocol):
- `4330` — normal path, inside `atmosphereRuntime.whenReady()` (atmosphere LUT bake ~8–14 s; ~43 s on weak GPU).
- `3968` / `5215` — wire-agent/`?wireframe=1` path fires `ready` immediately (atmosphere/composer/clouds/skydome/CSM skipped) so autoLogin doesn't time out at 90 s.

**Consequence for bots:** `ready` is a *render* gate that lags `in-world` and, under `?wireframe=1`, can fire *before* full population. **Gate protocol bots on `in-world` (kind=7), not `ready`.** Note the history caveat baked into the code itself (`9662-9677`): a fast boot can land on `ready` and you'll miss `in-world` as the *current* value — always check `__bootStateHistory.some(e => e.state==='in-world')`, not just `__bootState`.

## Global attach timing (what is live when)

| Global | Set at | Available |
|---|---|---|
| `window.entityMap` | `index.html:3017` | module init — **before login** (empty until spawn) |
| `window.getLocalPlayerGuid/setLocalPlayerGuid` | `index.html:3015-3016` | module init |
| `window.getLocalPlayerPose` | `index.html:1432` (dynamic shim → `__sessionHandle`) | module init; **survives disconnect/reconnect**, returns null pre-login |
| `window.__sessionHandle` | `index.html:5313` | **on Connect resolve** (`start_session`/`startNetWorkerSession`) |
| `window.__pluginClient` | post-login facade; await `window.__pluginClientReady` (`1423`) | after login; self-registers events |
| `window.liveScene3d` | `scene3d/index.js:3351` | after `init3D` — **3D path only** |
| `window.__diag` | `scene3d/diag.js:462`, `index.js:430` | 3D path only |
| recv kind=14 (combat events) | `index.html:7964` | after in-world |

**Late-attach trap:** `__sessionHandle`, `__pluginClient`, `liveScene3d`, `__diag` are all null/absent pre-login and (for the last two) require the 3D module to finish init. k1 correctly uses optional chaining everywhere (`window.__sessionHandle?.…`, `window.liveScene3d?.entityManager?.…`). A production harness must poll for presence, not assume.

## Account-In-Use / relogin semantics (searched & verified)

Two wire signals, both surfaced as JS globals for the orchestrator:
- **kind=20 `CharacterError`** (`index.html:7252-7273`), stashed to `window.__lastCharacterError` (`7264`):
  - `Logon (0x01)` → *account in use elsewhere*; ACE terminates the new session mid-handshake and **also kicks the old** session (`7256-7258`).
  - `EnterGameCharacterInWorld (0x0D)` → character still in-world; char-level logout pending (ACE takes **5–10 s**, `9538-9543`); needs `charInWorldWaitMs` (7000, `9571`) before retry.
- **kind=4 `Disconnected`** (`index.html:7204-7251`), stashed to `window.__lastDisconnect` (`7214`); paints a fixed red `#hbDisconnectBanner` (`7225-7238`) when already in-world; reaps stale entities via `clearWorldEntities()` (`7249`) so an in-page reconnect doesn't double-spawn.

**Current recovery model** (`9490-9525`): a **single clean Connect** clears a stale session (ACE boots it "in favor of new connection") — no retry-dance by default, because the dance opens a 2nd login session that ACE boots the 1st with (self-race on slow cold-boot spawn). The retry-dance is opt-in via `?maxRetries=N`. Harnesses avoid colliding with ACE's session reap using an **inter-arm quiet-gap of 65 s** (ACE's 60 s network-timeout reap of abruptly-closed sockets, `9496-9497`).

## (a) Canonical bot boot recipe

**URL** (matches the shipped spellcasting-bot harness, e.g. `docs/spellcasting-packets-2026-07-12/WS01-*.md`):
```
http://127.0.0.1:8765/apps/holtburger-web/index.html?nosw=1&nullRender=1&renderOnDemand=1&netDrainHz=30&autoLogin=1&account=X&password=X&autoSpawn=first&agent=1
```
- `nosw=1` — kill the SW shard-cache (avoids the tunnel/stale-cache trap); `nullRender=1` — zero GPU submit; `renderOnDemand=1` — no rAF spin; `netDrainHz=30` — keeps wire drain + pose current while rAF idles (**required** with `renderOnDemand`, else the `singleDriver` net path starves — `scene3d/index.js:764-779`); `autoLogin=1&account&password&autoSpawn=first` — hands-free Connect+Spawn; `agent=1` — CSS chrome-strip (cosmetic, `autoLogin` already implies it). Add `&bridge_url=…&server_host=…&server_port=…` (`5214-5227`) for remote/tunnel.
- For a **true zero-GPU** bot also add `&wireframe=1` — otherwise the atmosphere LUT bake still runs to fire `ready` (`scene3d/index.js:4020`, `696`).

**Readiness gates to poll (in order):**
1. `#results` innerHTML contains `PASS` — wasm smoke validated (`index.html:1983`, k1 uses it `118-124`). *Not* required if you trust `holtburger:state`.
2. `window.__bootStateHistory.some(e => e.state === 'in-world')` — **the real protocol-level ready gate** (kind=7 EnteredWorld).
3. `window.__sessionHandle?.getLocalPlayerPose()` returns non-null — handle live and player located.
4. `window.entityMap.size > 0` after `@telepoi`/spawn — world streamed in.
- Prefer the machine-readable `holtburger:state` CustomEvent (`5181`) / `__bootState` over k1's DOM polling (`#selection:not([hidden])`, `#login-status ~ /InWorld|Spawned/`, `#post-spawn`). In `agent`/`autoLogin` mode `#login-status` is hidden, so DOM gates are unreliable there.

**Known traps:**
- **SW cache** — a stale service worker serves the old wasm/JS. `?nosw=1` unregisters + clears + reloads once (sessionStorage-gated). k1's belt-and-suspenders (CDP `Network.clearBrowserCache` `68`, JS SW-unregister + `caches.delete` `75-92`, `?v=Date.now()` `95`) is the reliable pattern *after a rebuild* but re-downloads ~23 MB every run — only do it when the bundle changed.
- **Stale-pkg** — `serve.py` warns `DEV-SUSPECT` if `pkg` wasm >8 MB (`74-75`) or predates the last Rust commit (`174`); the page itself shows a `#hb-stale-wasm-banner` when `wasmManifest < EXPECTED_WASM_MANIFEST_VERSION` (`index.html:2038-2045`). A bot must check for this banner or it silently drives degraded gameplay.
- **Account-In-Use on relogin** — see table above; expect a first Connect to *kick* an in-world char and take 5–10 s to clear. Don't hammer: respect the 65 s reap gap or use `?maxRetries` (which itself waits `charInWorldWaitMs`=7 s on 0x0D).
- **Late-attached helpers** — poll for `__sessionHandle`/`liveScene3d`, never assume.
- **`ready` ≠ in-world** — gate on `in-world`.

## (b) Production harness spec (improving on k1)

k1 is a single-shot validation script: `connectOverCDP` to an already-running Chrome (`49`), raw form-fill + submit (`130-137`), fixed 3×12 s login retry (`151-156`), DOM polling, one hardcoded account, `process.exit` on any failure, no post-spawn disconnect watch. Production needs:

| Concern | k1 today | Production harness |
|---|---|---|
| **Process supervision** | none — one `(async()=>{})()`, exits | Supervisor (Node/systemd) owns each Chrome + page; restart on crash/`pageerror`; health = `__bootState`+heartbeat `window.__lastPumpMs` (`scene3d/index.js:2413`) freshness. Prefer `?autoLogin` (page self-drives) over external form-fill. |
| **Login retry** | blind 3×12 s sleep | Drive `?autoLogin`, then poll `__bootState`; on `error` inspect `__lastCharacterError.code` (0x01 → wait 65 s reap or `?maxRetries`; 0x0D → wait `charInWorldWaitMs`) and `__lastDisconnect`; exponential backoff; cap attempts. |
| **Disconnect detection** | none after spawn | Watch recv kind=4 via `__lastDisconnect` (`7214`) / the `#hbDisconnectBanner` (`7225`) / `getLocalPlayerPose()` going null / `__lastPumpMs` staleness. |
| **Re-login** | reload only (banner says "reload to reconnect" `7209`) | On disconnect: `location.reload()` to a fresh `?autoLogin` URL (cleanest — `clearWorldEntities` runs `7249`; in-page reconnect is unproven), honoring the 65 s reap gap. `__runAutonomousLogin({...})` (`9907`) is re-triggerable but the reload path is the tested one. |
| **Multi-account** | one hardcoded `tailnet1` (`28-29`) | One Chrome page (or browser context) per account; each URL carries its own `?account&password`. |

**`serve.py` setup for multi-account** (read `scripts/serve.py`): the server is a **stateless static file server** — `ThreadingHTTPServer`, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive (`282`), `request_queue_size=1024` (`381`), default port `8765` (`334`, env `PORT`), `--bind 127.0.0.1` default (`335`), serves the whole `external/holtburger/` tree (`285`). **It holds no per-client/per-account state**, so multi-account needs *zero* server changes — just open N pages against the same origin. What it *does* enforce: baked-layer validation (`die_loud` if `manifest.json`/`shards`/`scenery`/`spawns` missing, `366-367`; `--allow-missing` to bypass for UI-only) and cache headers (shards immutable-forever gated on 2xx `304`; `.js/.mjs/.wasm/.bin/.hba` `no-cache`/revalidate `306-313`; everything else `no-store` `315`). For **remote** multi-account browsers pass `--bind 0.0.0.0` (or front with `proxy.cjs`, the port-8765 contract `41`) and set each page's `?bridge_url/server_host/server_port` (`5214-5227`). The real multiplexing constraint is downstream: every web session rides one wsbridge WS→UDP mapping (`apps/holtburger-wsbridge`), and each account needs a distinct ACE login — the HTTP server is not the bottleneck.

## (c) Resource budget — `nullRender` vs. rendering page

**What `?nullRender=1` skips** (all in `scene3d/index.js`, per-frame GPU submission):
- `atmospherePipeline.render()` + `preFrameSkySync` + cloud overlay `preRender`/`renderOverlay` + `recordRenderDiag` — gated out by `if (!nullRender)` at `2214`.
- `skyDome.renderSkyPass()` **and** `renderer.render(scene, camera)` — early `return` before them at `2258-2264` (fallback path).
- Adaptive-resolution smart-default init (`931`) and the `AdaptiveRenderScaleController` rAF loop (`975-980`).

**What still runs under `nullRender`** (per the code's own comment `2259-2262`): simulation, protocol drain (`pollEntityUpdates`, `std::mem::take`), scene-graph mutation (cell visibility, PVS expansion, `drainEntityEvents3D`, animation mixers), local-player pose. **The canvas freezes at boot-time content.** Combined with `renderOnDemand=1` (no rAF re-arm, `2322-2325`) + `netDrainHz=N` (setInterval drain, `2358-2402`) → the wire loop is the only moving part = **zero-GPU-per-frame agent**.

**Cost comparison:**

| | Rendering page (default 3D) | `?nullRender=1 &renderOnDemand=1 &netDrainHz=30` |
|---|---|---|
| Per-frame GPU submit | full composer: sky + world + atmosphere + clouds + bloom/vignette + CSM | **none** |
| rAF | continuous (up to `targetFps`) | one boot frame, then idle (`717-722`) |
| Adaptive-res controller | running (own rAF loop) | disabled (`978`) |
| One-time atmosphere LUT bake | yes (~8 s GTX1070, ~43 s R9 290) | **still runs** unless `+?wireframe=1` (`696`, `4020`) |
| CPU (net/sim) | full | net drain @ N Hz + sim only |
| Canvas | live | frozen at boot |

Caveat: `nullRender` is **per-frame GPU only**; the atmosphere bake (needed to fire `ready`) and initial terrain/statics bake still consume GPU/CPU at boot. For a genuinely GPU-free fleet member add `?wireframe=1` (skips atmosphere/clouds/skydome/CSM, fires `ready` immediately at `3968`/`5215`).

## (d) Open questions / risks

1. **`ready` never fires for a pure-protocol bot without the 3D render module reaching atmosphere-ready.** Under `nullRender` the bake still runs and fires `ready` (`4330`), but if a future config skips the 3D module entirely (`?renderer=2d`), the only render-side terminal signal is gone — bots **must** gate on `in-world`/`__bootStateHistory`, not `ready`. Confirm the shipped fleet does this.
2. **Poll-vs-async inversion** (established workflow fact): RynthAi expects synchronous `TryGet*`; the web exposes `__bootState`, `entityMap`, `getLocalPlayerPose()`, `SessionHandle` methods only as poll-from-JS with rAF/`netDrainHz` cadence. `netDrainHz` caps at 60 (`752`) → max ~16.6 ms observation granularity; RynthAi's host tick may want tighter. Unmeasured whether 60 Hz drain is enough fidelity for combat timing.
3. **`netWatchdog` interaction** (`scene3d/index.js:2404-2439`, default-ON): under Chrome tab-occlusion throttle, rAF/pump clamps; the watchdog re-drives at 500 ms only when `__lastPumpMs` stale >1 s. A backgrounded bot fleet may see world-update stalls between watchdog ticks. `netDrainHz` mitigates but the two safety nets' interaction under many tabs is untested here.
4. **Multi-account scaling limits unverified**: `serve.py` handles the HTTP fan-out (queue 1024), but the wsbridge UDP-port mapping and ACE's per-account session model are the real ceiling — not read in this task.
5. **Cache-bust cost**: k1's full clear re-downloads ~23 MB/run. A production fleet needs a "bundle changed?" check (compare `_health.json` wasm mtime/`profile_guess`, `serve.py:154-177`) to avoid gratuitous re-streams; mechanism not yet built.
6. **`__pluginClient` readiness race**: it self-registers post-login via a poll (`2550-2564`); the `__pluginClientReady` promise (`1423`) is the correct gate, but k1 and some harnesses touch `__pluginClient.events` directly (k1 `304-316`) with only optional chaining — events registered before the client exists are silently dropped. Harness must `await __pluginClientReady` before wiring combat-event listeners.
7. **Doc integrity**: every bot-flag line ref in `url-flags.md` is stale and three defaults are wrong (see tables). Any harness generated *from the doc* rather than the code will emit wrong timeouts/retries — regenerate emitters from code (there is already an `L3` lint `lint-harness-params.mjs` guarding against re-minted dead params, per `url-flags.md` `n`-row).
